mechanism.claim: Momentum and reversal behavior estimated across quiet and volatile decisions can obscure regime-specific performance. Score formulaic 4h/24h experts only on causally matured prior decisions that were themselves in the high-variation state, and trade the first daily boundary where the positive-score conditional winner changes.
mechanism.side: current side emitted by the new highest mean high-variation-conditioned gross-log-payoff expert
mechanism.why_distinct: HVDOER and HVOER score every mature label regardless of the volatility state at label origin. HVTCEC uses unconditional top-two concordance and no winner transition. HVSCER uses only prior high-variation-origin labels and emits a positive-score conditional winner transition; no prior event set or control is reused.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: current completed eight-hour variation and every learning-label origin must have causal rank at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse offset state-conditioned winner rotations are absent from Gross9 calendars

returns.r4: log(last completed close/completed close exactly 4h earlier)
returns.r24: log(last completed close/completed close exactly 24h earlier)

features.counterfactual_label: expert side at prior daily decision times times log(open at prior entry+24h/open at prior entry); label matures only when exit open is observed
features.label_origin_gate: include a mature label only if its origin decision had a finite causal variation rank>=0.65
features.online_score: arithmetic mean gross log payoff before costs over latest at most 60 included mature labels, minimum 30; largest wins and frozen expert order breaks ties
features.rotation: current conditional winner differs from immediately prior consecutive ranking-valid conditional winner
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared 96 exact completed 5m intrabar log(close/open) returns over prior 8h)
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid daily decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65

causal_label_authorization.allowed: only fixed expert labels whose exit open is observed at or before current decision

clock.reservation: daily opportunities are nonoverlapping; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact held settlements after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

definitions.no_positive_score: conditional winner rotations regardless of score sign
definitions.one_decision_stale_winner: prior conditional winner side on primary clock

source_plan.live_extension: read-only Postgres BTCUSDT 1m through 2026-08-01 with overlap parity
source_plan.economic_execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent volatility-state-conditioned causal expert learning mechanism

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no expert, memory, label, rotation, variation, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
